{{NPC Infobox |name = Leviathan |image = Leviathan 4K.png |affiliation = Threnodians |title = The False Divinity |nation = Rinascita |child = [[Cartethyia]], [[Mya]] }} {{Quote|"Fleurdelys, my Resonator, why dost thou persist? Why abandon thy oath? Why hinder the spread of my gospel? The one blessed by the Dark Tide shall return to us. Continue thy disobedience at the risk of insanity. My most beloved Resonator, why persist in the error of thy ways?" |Leviathan (assimilated with Imperator) towards Cartethyia }} '''Leviathan''' is the [[Threnodian]] of [[Rinascita]] and is the main antagonist of [[Chapter II|Chapter II:]] [[Chapter II|Even When Divinity Remains Silent]]. It is recognized as the Threnodian of Unity, a shadow that seized humanity's "longing for Unity" and shaped by its "fear of the sea" as mentioned by its counterpart, the [[Sentinel]] [[Imperator]]. It has direct control over the native [[Waveworn Phenomenon]] of Rinascita, the [[Dark Tide]]. It had previously been bound within [[Fleurdelys]] by [[Cartethyia]], a state that persisted until the intervention of the [[Rover]] albeit already embedded in the Ragunnesi's collective consciousness. The [[Fractsidus]], under the leadership of the Overseer [[Cristoforo]], sought to fully revive the Threnodian, orchestrating the events of Chapter II: Even When Divinity Remains Silent. == Synopsis == === Origins of Leviathan === [[File:Leviathan Origins Story.jpg|thumb|344x344px|Leviathan's first appearance in Ragunna as humanity's "longing for Unity" and shaped by its "fear of the sea".]] In [[Chapter II]]: Act X - [[The Bygone Shall Always Return]], Imperator reveals the truth and origins of Rinascita and its ties to Leviathan. [[File:Leviathan False Miracles.jpg|thumb|338x338px|It spoke in Imperator’s name, wrought false miracles, forged hollow grace, and fed upon stagnant, obedient minds.]] Before the establishment of Rinsacita, during the [[The Lament|Lament]], the Sentinel Imperator guided displaced peoples to an archipelago and left behind knowledge and technology - the [[Common Echo|Genesis Nexus]], for them to walk the path of freedom, enabling the rise of [[Ragunna City|Ragunna]] and the other city-states. Unity became the foundation of the early civilization. Leviathan, as per the nature of Threnodians being tied to the existence of civilization, emerged from humanity’s longing for unity and manifested as its shadow. Leviathan through its ability of assimilation and corruption, acted in Imperator’s name, produced false miracles, and infiltrated human belief systems from the civilization’s earliest days. Additionally, it states that Leviathan was born from the darker aspect of humanity’s longing for unity, shaped by fear of the sea, and existed as a corrupting influence from the dawn of civilization. [[File:Leviathan vs Imperator.jpg|thumb|339x339px|Leviathan and Imperator's first clash, spawning the Dark Tide.]] The Sentinel Imperator opposed Leviathan, triggering the first instance of the Waveworn Phenomenon, the [[Dark Tide]], which severely damaged Rinascita. Afterward, Imperator questioned its role and concluded that both it and Leviathan had attempted to shape civilization according to their own will, denying the people the right to choose. Additionally, it had concluded that civilizations are bound to Threnodians and that no permanent solutions exists as of the moment. In another version of the story that was discovered by [[Carlotta]] alongside Rover - the story had two factions — one led by the progenitors of the Fisalia family — engaged in a theological conflict. This version of the struggle revolved around two divinities: one of the sky, Imperator, and one of the sea, Leviathan. These opposing forces were in perpetual discord, and their war ultimately catalyzed the emergence of civilization[[Chapter II]]: Act II - ''[[Veils Off in Sun or Shadow]] ('''Carlotta:''' …Once whole, the Divinity was rent by warring creeds. From Their holy wounds sprang the curse of Dark Tide . . .)'', which Imperator chose to preserve as part of its intrinsic role as a [[Sentinel]].Description of [[Sentinel|Sentinels]] In response to humanity's persistence, Leviathan initiated the First [[Dark Tide]], a catastrophic event aimed at purging both Rinascita and its Sentinel. === Current Day Ragunna and the Rover === In Cantarella's Companion Story - ''[[A Fleeting Night's Dream]],'' Cantarella reveals that the Fisalia's Divine Trials were designed to find a Blessed Maiden with an unbreakable will - someone who could withstand the Threnodian's influence, thus revealing as to why Cantarella is unaffected by the "spiritual plague", preserving her faith towards the Sentinel, allowing her to reveal to Rover both Imperator and Leviathan's corruption.[[File:Converge Threnodian.png|thumb|352x352px|One of the visions encountered by Rover during their first contact with Imperator-Leviathan depicting "Converge".]]As a Threnodian, it uses the Lament to pursue its intrinsic nature - in this case, the catastrophic [[Waveworn Phenomenon]] called the [[Dark Tide]]. Though two previous instances of the Dark Tide were already "thwarted" by [[Napoli II]] and [[Cartethyia]], Cantarella claims that the damage remains: ''"The tall mast of the galleon that is Ragunna has already been snapped in half,"'' a metaphor suggesting irreversible spiritual erosion. Infected individuals become increasingly detached from truth and reality, with Cantarella explaining that "once the soul fractures, the mind will follow until only a puppet remains." This indicates the Leviathan’s influence progresses from subtle manipulation to total domination. == Abilities == Leviathan possesses the ability to merge, assimilate, influence and infiltrate human civilization at a foundational level - a bastardization of "Unity" born from humanity's intrinsic nature to long for unification. In the Main Quest [[Chapter II]]: Act IV ''– [[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]]'', it was revealed to have corrupted and assimilated with the Sentinel Imperator during their first confrontation — eventually assuming a hybrid form of a hippocampus that was worshipped by the citizens of [[Ragunna]]. This hybridization has also allowed it limited access to the Sentinel's core memories and functions including the Sentinel's return pod allowing it to conceive an artificial Resonator to be its "vessel". The unique instance of Threnodian-Sentinel assimilation has led to the creation of [[Cartethyia]], the "Fleurdelys" being the artificial '''Sentinel Resonator''' of the hybrid entity.Main Quest [[Chapter II]]: Act IV ''– [[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]] ('''Imperator:''' We were of one body. Therefore, when Fleurdelys became Leviathan's Resonator, she also became mine.)'' Throughout the course of [[Chapter II]]: Act VI - [[Flames of Heart|''Flames of Heart'']], Cartethyia reveals that Leviathan had multiple failed "vessels" before her conception, one of which was the gladiator, [[Mya]]. Leviathan also has the ability to take root in the spiritual consciousness of the Ragunnesi, manipulating their beliefs and drawing them unknowingly toward [[Dark Tide|ruin through misguided faith]]. Main Quest [[Chapter II]]: Act IV ''– [[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]]'' ''(Enter Porto-Veno Castle)'' It facilitates this spread via the control imposed by the [[Order of the Deep]] and their current Primus, [[Fenrico]].Main Quest [[Chapter II]]: Act IV ''– [[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]] (Are you implying the Order worships the Threnodian? . . .)'' In the Main Quest [[Chapter II]]: Act IV ''– [[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]]'', [[Cantarella]], the current head of the Fisalia Family, reveals that the Leviathan "possesses the power to merge and assimilate" entire civilizations through the slow spread of "distorted beliefs" that function as a kind of "spiritual plague." Its method of conquest is not brute invasion, but gradual internal collapse, where the very soul of a culture is infected and transformed. She also states that it has already infiltrated both the beliefs of the Fisalia Family and the Order of the Deep. These are objectively called "Whispers" by various characters that the Rover encounters. As seen in the Quest Item ''[[A Transgressor's Transcript]]'', even with Tyrvine being under their possession, Leviathan has gradually assimilated the belief system of the Fisalias, with notable inconsistencies when compared to earlier historical records of miracles, dreams, and memories. Eventually, this also affects the Order of the Deep's teachings - affecting statues, anecdotes and proverbs''[[A Transgressor's Transcript]]''. This is further supported by the statements of the Bloom Bearer [[Ariosto]], who notes that the current statues of Imperator deviate from the records of the [[Black Shores|Black Shores']] [[Tethys System]]Dialogue with [[Ariosto]] in the [[Montelli Quarter]] ''('''Ariosto:''' You saw that Sentinel statue in Ragunna, right? . . .)''. With this development, Leviathan had already fully seized control of Ragunna through the worship of the hybrid entity, facilitated by the Order of the Deep and its followers, as well as the several supporters from Fisalia Family who are already affected by the entity. === The Dark Tide === The Dark Tide is a Waveworn Phenomenon, regionally present in Rinascita. It can both manifest both physically and metaphysically in those who are affected by Leviathan. The Tide itself is intrinsically linked to the existence of Leviathan and its revival, allowing it direct control over its appearance and the Dark Tide Creations that spawn alongside it. In Ragunna, the physical manifestation of the Dark Tide was being held by the Sonoro Sphere, [[Avinoleum]]. In Septimont, it is being held by the [[Earthrend Wedge]], with occasional peaking marked by the presence of the Blightcloud. ''For the complete properties and abilities of the Dark Tide, see [[Dark Tide]].'' === The Blightcloud === In parts of Rinascita where the faith in Imperator has not been established, specifically [[Septimont]] and the [[Sanguis Plateaus]] - it has been known to utilize the machinations of the [[Dark Tide]] rather than "spiritual corruption" in expand its influence, creating [[Tacet Discord]]s regionally called Dark Tide Creations under the Blightcloud - another Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Septimont characterized by a dark swirling mass above the Sanguis Plateaus. Dark Tide Creations uniquely exhibit the same ability of the Dark Tide to assimilate their victims into the Tide itself. === Journeying Paradise === The creation, sanctuary, and kingdom of Leviathan. It is a realm that resides within the Dark Tide and is a world where it's true purpose is to engulf Rinascita so they may live within it. One of the main purposes of the Dark Tide is to flood the Rinascita with the Dark Tide so that the Journeying Paradise may manifest into the real world itself. Through the Dark Tide, where Rinacita's subconscious beliefs flow and is made manifest, Leviathan used the conflict [[Cristoforo]] caused across Ragunna and Septimont to cause fear which in turn shaped the citizens desires for a blissful afterlife after death, which constructed the Journeying Paradise from these prayers where upon full manifestation, combined with Leviathan's power of assimilation, everyone will be forcibly made to have no thoughts and simply pray towards Leviathan with no will beyond blind devotion. (Fleurdelys) | * Successful Resonator of merged [[Imperator]] and Leviathan * "Daughter" |- |[[File:Mya In-game.png|50px]] |[[Mya]] | * Experimental Resonator * "Daughter" * Committed suicide 20 years ago to prevent Leviathan's resurgence |} ==Character Mentions== {{Character Mentions}} ==Gallery== File:Wuthering Waves Story Cinematics - Enlightened One File:Leviathan's physical form.png|Leviathan's physical vessel taking the appearance of the once Blessed Maiden, [[Fleurdelys]] and it's original form silhouette. ==Trivia== *In mythology and theology, [[wikipedia:Leviathan|Leviathan]] is a sea serpent demon and described as an embodiment of chaos. **In particular, in the ''[[wikipedia:Tractatus de Confessionibus Maleficorum et Sagarum|Tractatus de Confessionibus Maleficorum et Sagarum]]'', Leviathan is a demon that [[wikipedia:Peter Binsfeld|Peter Binsfeld]] associates with the capital sin of envy. *Cartethyia refers to Leviathan as the "False Divinity". ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Leviathan |zhs = 利维亚坦 |zht = 利維亞坦 |ja = レビヤタン |ko = 레비아탄 |es = Leviatán |fr = Léviathan |de = Leviathan }} ==References== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Deceased Characters]]
